<P STYLE="font: 11pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in"><B>NOTES TO THE CONSOLIDATED
FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in"><B>for the nine-month
period ended September 30, 2025 </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 11pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">1. &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Corporate
information and main business</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Central
Puerto S.A. (hereinafter the &#8220;Company&#8221;, or &#8220;CPSA&#8221;) and the companies that make up the business group (hereinafter
the &#8220;Group&#8221;) form an integrated group of companies related to the energy sector. The Group is mainly engaged in the generation
of electric power.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">CPSA was
incorporated pursuant to Executive Order No. 122/92 issued by the National Executive Branch, in accordance with Law No. 24,065, which
declared the generation, transmission, distribution, and commercialization of electricity subject to full privatization.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">On April 1, 1992, the
Awardee Consortium took possession of Central Puerto S.A., thereby initiating the operations of the new company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Our shares
are listed on the BYMA (&#8220;Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos&#8221;), and, since February 2, 2018, they have been listed on the NYSE (&#8220;New
York Stock Exchange&#8221;), both under the symbol &#8220;CEPU&#8221;.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">In order
to carry out our electric energy generation activity the Group owns the following assets:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 1.05pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.4pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 103%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The thermal power plants Puerto Nuevo and Nuevo Puerto, located in the City of Buenos Aires, with a total

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">In 2022,
under Resolution MEyM No. 281/2017, the Group was awarded the &#8220;Parque Solar San Carlos&#8221; project, with a capacity of 10 MW,
currently under construction in San Carlos, Salta Province.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On July
19, 2018, the National Gas Regulatory Authority (Enargas) registered the Company in the Enargas Registry of Traders and Trading Agreements.
Later, on March 22, 2024, the controlled company Puerto Energ&iacute;a S.A.U. was also registered as a natural gas trader in said registry,
and on September 20, 2024, it was authorized to join the Wholesale Electricity Market (&#8220;MEM&#8221;) as a Commercial Participant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Through
Proener S.A.U., a company fully controlled by CPSA, the Group participates in the forestry sector since Proener S.A.U. is the parent company
of: a) Forestal Argentina S.A., which owns approximately 141,000 hectares in Entre R&iacute;os and Corrientes provinces, of which approximately
67,000 hectares are planted with eucalyptus and pine, out of a total plantable area of approximately 77,500 hectares; and b) Loma Alta
Forestal S.A., which owns approximately 19,400 hectares in Corrientes province, of which approximately 10,400 hectares are planted with
pine.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Also, the
Group has begun to participate in the mining sector through an equity interest in the Diablillos silver and gold mining project located
in northwestern Argentina and&nbsp;an equity interest in the Tres Cruces lithium mining project&nbsp;located in the province of Catamarca.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Lastly,
the Group was linked to the natural gas distribution sector in the Cuyo and Central regions of Argentina through its equity investments
in the associate companies belonging to the ECOGAS Group. See Note 11.2.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The issuance
of the Group&#8217;s consolidated financial statements for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2025 was approved by the Company&#8217;s
Board of Directors on November 10, 2025.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">1.1. Summary of
the Argentine Electricity Market</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Transactions
among the different participants in the electricity industry take place through the wholesale electricity market (&#8220;WEM&#8221;) which
is a market in which generators, distributors and large users of electricity buy and sell electricity at prices determined by supply and
demand (&#8220;Term Market&#8221;) and also, where prices are established on an hourly basis based on production cost, represented by
the short-term marginal cost measured in the interconnection system (&#8220;Spot Market&#8221;). CAMMESA (Compa&ntilde;&iacute;a Administradora
del Mercado Mayorista El&eacute;ctrico Sociedad An&oacute;nima) is a quasi-governmental organization that was established to administer
the WEM and functions as a clearing house for the different market participants operating in the WEM. Its main functions include the operation
of the WEM, the dispatch of generation, the calculation of prices in the Spot Market, the real-time operation of the electricity system,
and&nbsp;the administration of commercial transactions in the electricity market.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">After the
Argentine economic crisis in 2001 and 2002 and after the end of the Convertibility Law, generation costs increased as a result of the
Argentine peso devaluation. In addition, the price of fuels used for power generation&nbsp;increased as well. The increasing generation
costs, combined with the&nbsp;freezing of end-user tariffs&nbsp;decided at the time by the administration, led to a permanent deficit
in CAMMESA&#8217;s accounts, and therefore
it faced difficulties to pay generators for energy purchases. Due to this structural deficit, the Secretariat of Energy enacted a series
of regulations to keep the electricity system operating despite the deficit.</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">c) Secretariat
of Energy Resolution No. 21/2025</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On January
28, 2025, Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 21/2025 was published in the Official Gazette, establishing that new conventional energy
generation projects, commercially commissioned as of January 1, 2025, may enter into supply contracts in the Term Market with Large Users
and Distributors. Additionally, Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 354/2020 was repealed, modifying certain considerations of the GasAr
Plan and the priorities for natural gas consumption in the Wholesale Electricity Market. It was also established that as of March 1, 2025,
generators selling their energy in the Spot Market may purchase their fuel, which will be recognized by CAMMESA according to the variable
production cost declared and recognized by the generator. The cost of unserved energy in the MEM was also set, with a maximum value of
1,500 USD/MWh when it exceeds 10% of the system demand. Finally, the Energ&iacute;a Plus Program was repealed, with existing contracts
remaining in effect until their termination.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">d) Secretariat
of Energy Resolution No. 67/2025</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On February
17, 2025, Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 67/2025 was published in the Official Gazette, through which the National and International
Open Call &#8220;Almacenamiento AlmaGBA&#8221; was authorized, with the purpose of entering into energy storage generation contracts with
MEM distributor agents Edenor and Edesur, and with CAMMESA as the last-resort payment guarantor, in accordance with the bidding terms
and conditions approved by this resolution.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">This new
energy storage system will allow coverage of short-duration capacity requirements and provide fast-response reserve services, as evidenced
by battery energy storage systems (&#8220;Battery Energy Storage Systems&#8221;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On July
15, 2025, the submission of bids took place. The Group submitted a 150 MW project at the Nuevo Puerto power plant and a 55 MW project
at the Costanera power plant. Both projects were awarded to the Group on September 1, 2025.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in"><B>e) Decree No. 450/2025</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On July
7, 2025, Decree No. 450/2025 was published in the Official Gazette, through which the National Executive Branch approved&nbsp;adjustments
and amendments&nbsp;to Electricity Laws No. 15,336 and No. 24,065, which constitute the Electricity Regulatory Framework,&nbsp;based on
the delegation provided under&nbsp;the Bases Law (see Note 13).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">In this
regard, the National Executive Branch emphasized that the delegation bases aim to recover the objective of reducing the intervention of
the National Government in the pricing and contracting system, in order to provide greater freedom to private actors and provide greater
legal certainty to ensure long-term supply. Additionally, the federal electricity regime is consolidated, preserving the supremacy of
the national regulatory framework over local provisions, so as not to hinder the free circulation of electricity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Accordingly,
Decree No. 450/2025 established a 24-month transition period for the modification of regulations and complementary standards as necessary,
during which the Secretariat of Energy was to undertake all necessary actions to ensure a gradual, orderly, and predictable transition
toward the objectives established in Article 2 of Law No. 24,065 and the full implementation of said law and its regulations.<BR>
Furthermore, it was established that during the transition period, the Secretariat of Energy would issue the necessary regulations for
its implementation.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in"><B>f) Secretariat of
Energy Resolution No. 400/2025</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">On October 20, 2025, Resolution
No. 400/2025 of the Energy Secretariat was published in the Official Gazette, through which the &#8220;Rules for the Normalization of
MEM and its Progressive Adaptation&#8221; were approved, which implement the modifications to MEM regulations established by Decree No.
450/2025, with application as from November 1, 2025.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The central objective
of these rules is to reformulate the MEM to establish a price system based on marginal costs, decentralize fuel management, and allow
demand to contract its supply through the Term Market (Mercado a T&eacute;rmino &#8211; MAT).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The Resolution No. 400/2025,
among its main points, establishes the following:</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 7.1pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 14.2pt">i.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Categories of demand for energy distributors, dividing them between demand that can contract its supply
(GUDI) and demand that cannot contract (Residential and Non-Residential). The latter will be mainly supplied by Assigned Generation, as
defined below.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 21.3pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 7.1pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 14.2pt">ii.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Assigned Generation comprises generation units (i) with existing MEM supply contracts, (ii) hydroelectric
plants under concession of the National Government, (iii) hydroelectric plants of binational entities, (iv) nuclear plants, and (v) energy
imports carried out in a centralized manner by the OED. The remuneration of Assigned Generation will remain based on contract values and/or
specific regulations issued by the Secretariat of Energy. Generation units not classified as Assigned Generation are considered Spot Generation
and may participate in the energy and power remuneration scheme and the MAT scheme described in section (iv) below, except for thermal
power plants in which ENARSA has a majority stake and combined-cycle generation units with power availability commitments under the Agreement
approved by Resolution SE No. 59/2023, which may terminate said agreement and formally adhere to the regime to participate in it.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 7.1pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 14.2pt">iii.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">New Generation is defined as all generation equipment whose commercial commissioning occurred on or after
January 1, 2025.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 7.1pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 14.2pt">iv.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">A scheme of fuel management and energy and power remuneration for Spot Market generation is defined, according
to the following terms:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 42.55pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">a. Fuel Management:</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Decentralization of fuel management (natural gas and alternative fuels) by generators.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Natural Gas (NG): While the Gas Plan remains in effect (until 2028), generators may access an &#8220;NG
Agreement&#8221; administered centrally by CAMMESA/ENARSA. However, self-management of NG is allowed, while full fuel management becomes
mandatory as of January 1, 2029.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Generators with self-managed fuel must freely declare their Variable Production Cost (CVP) within reference
ranges to compete in dispatch and recover costs (including fuel).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Generators without self-managed fuel will apply reference costs and will not access the marginal rent
scheme. Their power remuneration will gradually decrease until eliminated as of 2028, except when dispatched.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 42.55pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">b. Remuneration of
Spot Generation:</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The remuneration seeks to value both the offered cost (CVP) and the marginal rent, incentivizing competition.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Remuneration Formula:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Hourly Remuneration
Price = CVP + Adapted Marginal Rent (RMA), where RMA = (Hourly Marginal Cost &times; Loss Factor &#8211; CVP) &times; Adapted Rent Factor
(FRA).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><BR>
The FRA is the percentage of the marginal rent that is remunerated; it gradually increases for existing thermal, hydroelectric, and renewable
generation (i.e., prior to 2025) from 0.15 in 2025 to 0.35 in 2028, while for New Generation and those incorporating firm NG transport,
the FRA equals 1 (full access to rent).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Minimum Rent: Minimum rent values expressed in USD per MWh are established for existing thermal, hydroelectric,
and renewable generation.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 42.55pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">c. Remuneration of
Power:</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Power Made Available (PPAD): Remunerated during Power Remuneration Hours (HRP, typically 90 hours per
week) at a rate of USD 12 / MW available per HRP hour (with multiplier factors depending on fuel type and season).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Base Reliability Reserve Service (SRC Base): Payment of USD 1,000 / MW per month for power available from
existing thermal generation.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Additional Reliability Reserve Service (SRC Additional): Differential payment of USD 9,000 / MW per month
for new hydrothermal generation or low-utilization storage at nodes required by the SADI.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 42.55pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">d. Demand Allocation
and Prices:</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Distributor demand is divided and the price signal is redirected.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Seasonalized Demand of Distributors: Includes Residential demand (priority 1) and Non-Residential demand
(priority 2) and will be supplied by Assigned Generation. Wholesale costs for this demand will reflect the average costs of the Assigned
Generation.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Spot Demand (Large Users, Uncovered Demand): Prices will reflect system costs, with a gradual incorporation
of the Hourly Marginal Cost.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 42.55pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">e. Term Market (MAT):</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The MAT for energy and power is promoted as the main contracting mechanism, with the objective of allowing
demand (Distributors and Large Users) to freely contract their supply with generators, obtaining physical backing and price stability.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 52.9pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 18pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; line-height: 115%">&#8211;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Existing thermal and hydro generation has limits on its capacity to contract with Large Users (maximum
20% of its monthly production) until January 1, 2030.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

will be deducted from their obligation to purchase power made available in the Spot market.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt 21.3pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 7.1pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 14.2pt">v.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Any new demand in the MEM that is directly connected to the High-Voltage Transmission System, and that
represents a relative increase exceeding 0.5% of the average demand of the MEM, must accompany its request for access to the MEM and transmission
capacity with the submission of a supply plan that ensures (i) at least 80% of new energy production; and (ii) sufficient physical power

of preparation of the consolidated financial statements</P>

<P STYLE="font: 9pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">2.1. Professional
accounting standards applied</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The Group
prepares its condensed consolidated financial statements in accordance with the regulations in force of the Argentine Securities Commission
(&#8220;CNV&#8221;) set forth in&nbsp;Chapter III, Title IV of the CNV Regulations (N.T. 2013 as amended). Under Article 1 of&nbsp;this
section of the Regulations, issuers of marketable securities must present their condensed consolidated financial statements applying Technical
Resolution 26 of the Argentine Federation of Professional Councils in Economic Sciences (&#8220;FACPCE&#8221;), which provides for the
application of the International Financial Reporting Standards (&#8220;IFRS&#8221;) issued by the International Accounting Standards Board
(&#8220;IASB&#8221;), together with&nbsp;its amendments and IFRS adoption circulars that FACPCE may establish in accordance with such
Technical Resolution. In particular, interim condensed financial statements must apply the International Accounting Standard 34 (&#8220;IAS&#8221;)
&#8220;Interim Financial Reporting&#8221;.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">2.2. Basis of presentation
and consolidation</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">These condensed
consolidated financial statements for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2025 have been prepared applying the financial information
framework prescribed by the CNV as mentioned in note 2.1.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">In preparing
these condensed consolidated financial statements, the Group has applied the main accounting policies and the significant accounting judgments,
estimates and assumptions described in notes 2.3 and 2.4 to the financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2024, already issued.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">These condensed
consolidated financial statements contain all the necessary information for a proper understanding by users of the relevant facts and
transactions that occurred after the issuance of the last annual financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2024 and up to the
date of&nbsp;issuance of&nbsp;these interim condensed consolidated financial statements. However, these condensed consolidated financial
statements include
neither all the information nor the disclosures required for the annual financial statements prepared in accordance with IAS 1 (Presentation
of financial statements). Therefore, these condensed consolidated financial statements must be read together with the annual financial
statements for the year ended December 31, 2024.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The Group&#8217;s
consolidated financial statements are presented in Argentine pesos, which is the Group&#8217;s functional currency, and all values have
been rounded to the nearest thousand (ARS 000), except when otherwise indicated.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">2.2.1. Measuring
unit</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The interim
condensed consolidated financial statements as of September 30, 2025, including comparative figures for the previous fiscal year,&nbsp;have
been restated&nbsp;to consider the changes in the general purchasing power of the functional currency of the Company (Argentine peso)
pursuant to IAS 29 and General Resolution No. 777/2018 of the Argentine Securities Commission,&nbsp;without this affecting the decisions
taken based on the financial information for such period. Consequently, the financial statements are expressed in the current unit of
measurement at the end of the reporting period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The effects
of the application of IAS 29 are disclosed in Note 2.2.2 to the consolidated financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2024,
already issued.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Considering
the mentioned index, the inflation was 21.97% and 101.58% for the nine-month periods ended September 30, 2025 and 2024, respectively.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt"><B>2.3. Changes in significant
accounting policies</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">New standards and
interpretations adopted</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Starting
from the fiscal year beginning on January 1, 2025, the Group has applied for the first time certain new and/or amended standards and interpretations
as issued by the IASB.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Below is
a brief description of the new and/or amended standards and interpretations adopted by the Group and their impact on these consolidated
financial statements:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">Lack of exchangeability
- Amendments to IAS 21</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The amendments
specify how an entity must assess whether a currency is exchangeable and how it must determine a spot exchange rate when exchangeability
is lacking. The amendments also require the disclosure of information that enables users of the financial statements to understand how
the lack of exchangeability of a currency affects, or is expected to affect, the entity&#8217;s financial performance, financial position,
and cash flows.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The amendments
are effective for annual reporting periods beginning on or after January 1, 2025. When applying the amendments, entities are not permitted
to restate comparative information.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">These amendments
have not had a significant impact on the Group&#8217;s consolidated financial statements.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt"><B>CVO receivables:
</B>As described in Note 1.2.a), in 2010 the Company approved an agreement with the former Energy Secretariat (the &#8220;CVO Agreement&#8221;)
and effective as of March 20, 2018, CAMMESA granted&nbsp;commercial authorization for the combined cycle operation&nbsp;of the Central
Vuelta de Obligado thermal power plant (the &#8220;Commercial Authorization&#8221;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Receivables
under the CVO Agreement are included in &#8220;Trade receivables - CAMMESA&#8221;. CVO receivables are denominated in US dollars and accrue
interest at a rate of LIBOR plus 5%. Due to the discontinuation of the LIBOR rate, which occurred on June 30, 2023, for the purpose of
determining the applicable interest, this rate has been replaced by the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) published in the CME source
(Chicago Mercantile Exchange) plus a fixed spread of 0.11448%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">As a consequence
of the Commercial Authorization and in accordance with the CVO agreement, the Company collects the CVO receivables in 120 equal and consecutive
installments.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">During the
nine-month periods ended September 30, 2025 and 2024, collections of CVO receivables amounted to 67,397,239 and 78,369,966, respectively.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Information
on the Group&#8217;s objectives and policies for managing credit risk is included in Note 17 to consolidated financial statements for
the year ended December 31, 2024.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in"><B>7.3.1. Loans from International
Finance Corporation (&#8220;IFC&#8221;) and Inter-American Investment Corporation (&#8220;IIC&#8221;)</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On October
20, 2017 and January 17, 2018, CP La Castellana S.A.U. and CP Achiras S.A.U. (both of which are subsidiaries of CPR), respectively, entered
into agreements with: (i) International Finance Corporation (IFC) on its own behalf, as Eligible Hedge Provider and as an implementing
entity of the Managed Co-Lending Portfolio Program; (ii) Inter-American Investment Corporation (&#8220;IIC&#8221;), as lender on its behalf,
acting as agent for the Inter-American Development Bank (&#8220;IDB&#8221;) and on behalf of IDB as administrator of the Canadian Climate
Fund for the Private Sector in the Americas (&#8220;C2F&#8221;, and together with IIC and IDB, &#8220;Group IDB&#8221;, and together with
IFC, &#8220;Senior Creditors&#8221;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">In accordance
with the terms of the agreement entered into by CP La Castellana S.A.U., USD 5 million accrue an interest rate equal to LIBOR plus 3.5%,
and the rest at LIBOR plus 5.25%, until August 15, 2023. As a consequence of the discontinuation of the LIBOR rate, which occurred on
June 30, 2023, CP La Castellana S.A.U., together with IDB Group and IFC amended the loan agreements on June 29, 2023, replacing the LIBOR
rate with the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) plus a fixed Credit Adjustment Spread (CAS) of 0.26161% applicable from August 15,
2023. The loan is amortizable quarterly in 52 equal and consecutive installments starting February 15, 2019.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">In accordance
with the terms of the agreement entered into by CP Achiras, USD 40.7 million accrue a fixed interest rate equal to 8.05%, and the rest
accrue a 6.77% fixed interest rate. The loan is amortizable quarterly in 52 equal and consecutive installments starting May 15, 2019.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">As per the
executed loan agreement and among other obligations undertaken, the subsidiaries CP La Castellana and CP Achiras have committed to maintain
a Historical Senior Debt Service Coverage Ratio of at least 1.05:1.00, and such ratio shall not be lower than 1.20:1.00 for more than
eight consecutive quarters. These ratios must be maintained until the project completion date and are calculated by dividing the sum of
EBITDA for the most recent four financial quarters prior to the calculation date by the sum of all scheduled debt payments due in those
same four quarters.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">In addition,
as a guarantee of the obligations undertaken, the subsidiaries CP La Castellana and CP Achiras have a pledge in favor of IFC and IIC with
a first degree recording on the financed assets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Other related
agreements and documents, such as the Guarantee and Sponsor Support Agreement (the</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&#8220;Guarantee
Agreement&#8221; under which CPSA fully, unconditionally and irrevocably guarantees, as principal debtor, all payment obligations undertaken
by CP La Castellana and CP Achiras until the projects reach the project compliance date) hedging agreements, guarantee trusts, a mortgage,
guarantee agreements on shares, guarantee agreements on wind turbines, direct agreements and promissory notes have been signed.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">As of February
16, 2023, CP La Castellana and CP Achiras have fulfilled all the requirements and conditions to certify the occurrence of the project&#8217;s
compliance date. As a result, the Guarantee Agreement posted by CPSA was released.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The Company
also agreed to maintain, unless otherwise consented to in writing by each senior lender, ownership and control of the CP La Castellana
and CP Achiras as follows: (i) until each project completion date, (a) it shall maintain (x) directly or indirectly, at least seventy
percent (70%) beneficial ownership of CP La Castellana and CP Achiras; and (y) control of the CP La Castellana and CP Achiras; and (b)
CP Renovables shall maintain (x) directly, ninety-five percent (95%) beneficial ownership of CP La Castellana and CP Achiras;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">7.3.2. Loan from
Kreditanstalt f&uuml;r Wiederaufbau (&#8220;KfW&#8221;)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On March
26, 2019, the Company entered into a loan agreement with KfW for an amount of up to USD 56 million to finance the acquisition of two gas
turbines, equipment and related services corresponding to the Luj&aacute;n de Cuyo cogeneration plant project.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">In accordance
with the terms of the agreement, the loan accrues an interest rate of LIBO plus 1.15%. Due to the discontinuation of the LIBO rate, which
occurred on June 30, 2023, the Company and KfW amended the loan agreement on June 30, 2023, replacing the LIBO rate with the Secured Overnight
Financing Rate (SOFR) plus a Credit Adjustment Spread (CAS) of 0.26161%. The loan is amortizable quarterly in 47 equal and consecutive
installments starting six months after the commissioning of the gas turbines and their equipment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Pursuant
to the loan agreement, among other obligations, CPSA must maintain a leverage ratio of no more than 3.5:1.00 as of December 31 of each
year. The Company has complied with this requirement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">As of September
30, 2025 and December 31, 2024, the balance of this loan amounted to 28,898,407 and 28,688,932, respectively.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt"><B>7.3.3. Loan from

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

21, 2019, Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U., a CPSA subsidiary, signed a loan agreement with IFC, acting on its own behalf, as Eligible Hedge
Provider and as implementing entity of the Managed Co-Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP) administered by IFC, for an amount of USD 76.1
million.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Pursuant
to the terms of the agreement signed with Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U., this loan accrued an interest rate equal to LIBO plus 6.50% until
August 15, 2023. Due to the discontinuation of the LIBO rate, which occurred on June 30, 2023, Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U. together with
IFC amended this agreement on June 14, 2023, replacing the LIBO rate with the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) plus a Credit Adjustment
Spread (CAS) of 0.26161% applicable from August 15, 2023. The loan is amortizable quarterly in 55 consecutive installments starting November
15, 2020.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">As per the
executed loan agreement and among other obligations undertaken, the subsidiary Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U. has committed to maintain a
Historical Senior Debt Service Coverage Ratio of at least 1.05:1.00,
and such ratio shall not be lower than 1.20:1.00 for more than eight consecutive quarters. Such ratio is calculated by dividing the sum
of the EBITDA for the most recent four financial quarters prior to the calculation date by the sum of all scheduled debt payments due
in those four quarters.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt"><BR>

by Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires S.A. in connection with the merger of CPRES, CP Manque S.A.U., and CP Los Olivos</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On May 24,
2019, CPRES (a company now absorbed by Vientos La Genoveva II S.A.U.) signed a loan agreement with Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires S.A.
for an amount of USD 12.5 million to finance the construction of the &#8220;La Castellana II&#8221; wind farm. According to the terms
of the agreement, the loan accrued a fixed interest rate of 8.5% during the first year, increasing by half a percentage point annually
until the sixty-first interest period, and is amortizable quarterly in 25 installments starting May 24, 2020.<BR>
<BR>
</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Under the
loan agreement, the subsidiary CPRES had committed to maintain certain financial ratios until full repayment of the outstanding amounts.
From June 29, 2024, to June 28, 2025, the subsidiary CPRES obtained waivers for compliance with such ratios and other obligations under
the agreement, in relation to losses due to claims included under &#8220;Other operating expenses&#8221; in the statement of profit or
loss for the year ended December 31, 2024. As a result of the corporate reorganization through which CPRES was absorbed by Vientos La
Genoveva II S.A.U., since June 18, 2025, the applicable ratios are those previously mentioned in connection with the loan granted to Vientos
La Genoveva II.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt"><BR>

in favor of Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires S.A. over the financed assets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt"><BR>

and irrevocably guaranteed, as principal debtor, all payment obligations assumed by Vientos La Genoveva II S.A.U. and CPRES until full
repayment of the guaranteed obligations or until the project reaches its project compliance date, whichever occurs first, share pledge
agreements, turbine pledge agreements, direct agreements, and promissory notes have been executed.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt"><BR>

of the project compliance date, and therefore the Guarantee Agreement granted by CPSA was released.</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">7.3.5. Financial

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

framework of the acquisition of the Thermal Station Brigadier L&oacute;pez, the Company assumed the role of settlor under the financial
trust previously signed by Integraci&oacute;n Energ&eacute;tica Argentina S.A., which was the former owner of the plant. The financial
debt balance at the transfer date of the plant was USD 154,662,725.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">In accordance
with the provisions of the trust agreement, the financial debt accrued an interest rate equal to the LIBO rate plus 5% or equal to 6.25%,
whichever was greater, and was amortized monthly. On April 5, 2022, the outstanding balance was fully repaid.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 1.3pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Under the&nbsp;financial
trust agreement, as of September 30, 2025 and as of December 31, 2024, there are trade receivables with specific assignment amounting
to 884,757 and 1,079,105, respectively.</P>

Program</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On July
31, 2020, the Extraordinary General Shareholders&#8217; Meeting of the Company approved the creation of a new global program for the issuance
of notes for a maximum outstanding amount at any time during the term of the program of USD 500,000,000 (or its equivalent in other currencies),
to be issued as short-, medium- or long-term notes, simple, non-convertible into shares, under the terms of the Negotiable Obligations
Law (the &#8220;Program&#8221;). Additionally, the Board of Directors was granted authority to determine and establish the conditions
of the Program and of the negotiable obligations to be issued under it, insofar as such conditions were not expressly determined by the
shareholders&#8217; meeting. On October 29, 2020, the CNV approved the creation of the aforementioned Program. On June 11, 2025, the CNV
approved the extension of the Program&#8217;s term until October 29, 2030 and the increase of the Program&#8217;s amount up to USD 1,000,000,000.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Under this
Program, the Company issued three types of securities: (a) on September 17, 2023, the subscription and settlement of Class A Negotiable
Obligation (NO) took place, denominated, issued, and payable in U.S. dollars abroad; the characteristics of this NO are as follows: (i)
nominal value issued: USD 37,232,818, (ii) interest rate, determined through bidding: 7%, (iii) interest coupon frequency: semiannual,
(iv) amortization: bullet, (v) term: 30 months from September 17, 2023, and (vi) applicable law and deposit location: Argentina, Caja
de Valores S.A. (b) on October 17, 2023, the subscription and settlement of the international bond denominated &#8220;10% Senior Notes
due 2025&#8221; (Class B NO) took place, denominated, issued, and payable in U.S. dollars abroad, under the Reg S scheme. The characteristics
of this bond are as follows: (i) nominal value issued: USD 50,000,000, (ii) interest rate, determined through bidding: 10%, (iii) interest
coupon frequency: semiannual, (iv) amortization: bullet, (v) term: 24 months from October 17, 2023, and (vi) applicable law and deposit
location: New York, Euroclear; and (c) on August 25, 2025, the subscription and settlement of Class C NO took place, denominated, issued,
and payable in U.S. dollars abroad; the characteristics of this NO are as follows: (i) nominal value issued: USD 50,000,000, (ii) interest
rate, determined through bidding: 8%, (iii) interest coupon frequency: semiannual, (iv) amortization: bullet, (v) term: 48 months from
August 25, 2025, and (vi) applicable law and deposit location: Argentina, Caja de Valores S.A.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On October
20, 2023, the Company decided to reopen Class A NO, a procedure that allows offering in the market a security that replicates all the
conditions of the previously offered instrument, incorporating the interest rate determined in the original offering (7%) and bidding
the price. As a result of this process, the Company issued an additional USD 10,000,000 for Class A NO, with an issuance price of 102.9%.
Thus, the total nominal value of Class A amounts to USD 47,232,818.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On August
28, 2025, the Company decided to reopen Class C NO, issuing an additional USD 39,067,309 with an issuance price of 100.06%. Therefore,
the total nominal value of Class C amounts to USD 89,067,309.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On October
17, 2025, Class B NO was fully canceled.</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">7.3.8. Mitsubishi
Corporation Loan</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On November
29, 1996, the Company Central Costanera S.A. signed a contract with Mitsubishi Corporation for the installation of a turnkey combined
cycle power plant. The original agreement included financing of USD 192.5 million for 12 years from the provisional acceptance of the
project, with a fixed annual interest rate of 7.42% and semiannual amortization of principal and interest.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On October
27, 2014, Central Costanera S.A. and Mitsubishi Corporation agreed to the restructuring of this liability. Among the main restructuring
conditions, the following stand out: waiver of accrued and accumulated interest&nbsp;as of September 30, 2014 amounting to USD 66,061,897;
rescheduling of principal of USD 120,605,058 for an 18-year term, with a 12-month grace period, which must be fully repaid before December
15, 2032; a minimum annual payment of USD 3,000,000 in principal, in quarterly installments; a fixed annual interest rate of 0.25%; and
certain restrictions on dividend payments.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Considering
the restrictions imposed at the time by the Central Bank of Argentina (see Note 13), several amendments to the loan agreement have been
executed since September 30, 2020.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The loan
includes certain financial covenants, which as of September 30, 2025, have been fully complied with by Central Costanera S.A. Moreover,
as a guarantee of the obligations undertaken, Central Costanera S.A. maintains a pledge in favor of Mitsubishi Corporation with a first-ranking
registration on the financed asset, the amount of which has varied depending on the refinancing obtained.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">As a result
of the acquisition of the Gua&ntilde;izuil II A solar park, the Group assumed the liability corresponding to the loan granted to the subsidiary
Cordillera Solar VIII S.A., currently renamed CP Cordillera Solar S.A. (&#8220;CPCS&#8221;) by its former shareholder Equinor Wind Power
AS for a principal amount of USD 62,199,879 and interest of USD 8,983,951. As collateral for this loan, CPCS had previously granted a
first-ranking pledge over certain property, plant, and equipment of said company in favor of Equinor Wind Power AS.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On October
18, 2023, both parties agreed to a refinancing plan for a period of 24 months starting from the refinancing date, at an annual rate of
9%. Additionally, on that date, CPCS repaid a principal amount of USD 40 million with the funds obtained through the loan detailed in
Note 7.3.10.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Moreover,
as a result of the acquisition, the Group assumed the liability for the Junior Shareholder Loan Agreement granted to CPCS with an outstanding
balance of USD 1,768,897, which on October 18, 2023, was refinanced at a 9% annual rate, to be repaid 24 months after the refinancing
date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On September
6 and October 7, 2024, both loans were fully repaid, and the associated guarantees were canceled.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">7.3.10. Loan from
Banco Santander International</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On October
18, 2023, the subsidiary CPCS entered into a loan agreement with Banco Santander International for an amount of USD 40 million at an annual
rate of 6.5%, to be repaid 24 months after the loan granting date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">As of September
30, 2025 and December 31, 2024, the loan balance amounted to 56,844,500 and 51,020,368, respectively.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On October
20, 2025, the loan was fully repaid at maturity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">7.3.11. Short-term
loans for import financing</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On November
4, 2024, the subsidiary Central Costanera S.A. entered into a short-term loan agreement with Banco Santander S.A. (Uruguay) for a total
amount of USD 36,318 to finance the import of materials and equipment. This loan accrued interest at an effective annual interest rate
of 7%, with a scheduled maturity date of May 5, 2025. The loan was fully repaid at maturity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">As of December
31, 2024, the subsidiary Vientos La Genoveva II S.A.U. maintained various short-term loans with Banco Santander S.A. (Uruguay) totaling
USD 1,353,776. These loans accrued interest at an effective annual interest rate of 7%, with maturities between January 28, 2025 and March
9, 2025. The aforementioned loans were intended to finance the acquisition of solar trackers, panels, inverters, and transformation centers
to be installed at the San Carlos solar park and were repaid at maturity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in"><B>7.4. Quantitative and qualitative
information on fair values </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">Valuation techniques</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The fair
value reported for financial assets represents the amount at which the instrument could be exchanged in regular transaction between mutually
consenting parties, and not in a forced or liquidation transaction. The following methods and assumptions were used to estimate the fair
values:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.1pt 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">Management
has assessed that the fair values of current trade receivables approximate their carrying amounts, largely due to the short-term maturities
of these instruments.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The Group
assesses long-term receivables at fixed and variable rates based on discounted cash flows. The valuation requires that the Group adopt
certain assumptions such as interest rates, specific risk factors for each transaction and the creditworthiness of the customer.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The fair
value of quoted debt securities, mutual funds, stocks and negotiable bonds is based on the quoted prices as of the reporting period end
date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">The fair
value of debts and loans accruing interest approximates their book value.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt/104% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5pt">Fair value hierarchy</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 11pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">9. Equity
reserves</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On January
2, 2024, the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors decided to partially release the voluntary reserve intended for dividend payments so as
to distribute a dividend equivalent to 5.75 ARS per share (value in historical currency).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On April
30, 2024, the Shareholders&#8217; Meeting of the Company approved an increase in the legal reserve in the amount of 19,660,083 and resolved
to allocate the remaining unappropriated earnings as of December 31, 2023 to increase the voluntary reserve in order to be applied to
future dividend payments based on the evolution of the Company&#8217;s financial condition and in accordance with the Company&#8217;s
current dividend distribution policy.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On November
7, 2024, the Company&acute;s Board of Directors decided to partially release the voluntary reserve intended for dividend payments so as
to distribute a dividend equivalent to 39.47 ARS per share (value in historical currency).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.1pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">On April
30, 2025, the Company&#8217;s Shareholders&#8217; Meeting approved an increase in the legal reserve in the amount of 2,721,366 and resolved
to allocate the remaining unappropriated earnings as of December 31, 2024 to increase the voluntary reserve for dividend payments, based
on the evolution of the Company&#8217;s financial condition and in accordance with its current dividend distribution policy.</P>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

property tax paid by the Company under the substitute taxpayer regime.</P>

the Shareholders&#8217; Meetings of the companies involved, CPSA absorbs the assets and liabilities of the subsidiary CPR. Since CPSA
holds 100% of CPR&#8217;s shares, CPSA&#8217;s equity does not increase as a result of the merger, while the subsidiary CPR will be dissolved
without liquidation. On May 22, 2025, the corporate reorganization was approved by the respective Shareholders&#8217; Meetings. The effective
date of the merger was set for October 1, 2025, once the precedent conditions established in the Definitive Merger Agreement were fulfilled
and after the corporate reorganization was approved by the CNV on September 10, 2025.</P>

interest in AbraSilver Resource Corp. increased to 9.9%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/107% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.05pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt/103% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0.25pt 0.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.45pt">AbraSilver
Resource Corp. is a company listed on the Canadian stock exchange and holds the Diablillos silver and gold mining project located in northwestern
Argentina. The investment is measured at fair value as of the reporting date and classified under &quot;Other Financial Assets - Non-Current&quot;.</P>
